Tess: ok team tiny victory update 1717 48M monthly requests and steady growth. drumroll? :drum:
Harper: that's huge!! congrats y'all :tada: :rocket:
Miguel: plant potluck? someone bring a fern and i'll bring empanadas. :plant_potted:
Sonia: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-3o6ZtaO9BZHcOjmErm perfect for this vibe
Kai: poll: react 1 = plant potluck (SF office), 2 = virtual coffee + care packages, 3 = office sticker-swapping hour. vote now :smile:
Tess: small ask: ops, can we confirm there's no planned infra changes Friday? want zero surprises. @OpsBot
OpsBot: Tess asked about maintenance windows. Automated: No critical maintenance scheduled Friday-Sunday. Monitoring alerts normal.
Harper: if we do plant potluck, also let's do a tiny 'shoutout wall' where people post 1-line thanks to a teammate. i'll bring sticky notes.
Miguel: love the shoutout wall. shoutout to @Harper for the dashboard tweaks last week.
Sonia: kudos: big thanks to @Miguel for the deploy script fix that reduced build flakiness.
Kai: also kudos to @Sonia for the load test scenarios  caught an edge case early.
Tess: perfect. i'll collect the kudos and add them to the all-hands slide. also can someone draft a 30s speech? i'm terrible at public speaking.
Harper: i'll do a 30s riff. theme: "we kept it humming". corny but sincere.
Miguel: sample ops snippet for ordering small swag i used before:
```
/order-swag --item enamel-pin --qty 80 --ship-by 2026-06-01
```
Sonia: shipping note: remote folks, DM me address if you want a care package. planning to ship Wed.
Kai: timeline thought: quick celebration Friday 4pm PT, short slide, brief shoutouts, then optional snack hour.
Tess: 4pm PT works for EU overlap. remote folks we will livestream the 5-min shoutouts.
Harper: also can we have a silly photo contest? best team photo wins a plant. :camera_with_flash: :seedling:
Miguel: prize accepted. will start designing a ridiculous trophy plaque: "Kept the Trees Standing"
Sonia: budgeting question: ops/budget @OpsBot how much for 80 enamel pins + 40 care packages? rough range ok.
OpsBot: Sonia requested budget estimate. FinanceOps looped in. Typical estimate: pins $5-$8 each, care packages $20-$30 each depending on contents and shipping.
Tess: cool. i'll ping FinanceOps for formal approval. anyone else want to add a kudos before i lock the list?
Harper: shoutout to @Kai for the last-minute feature toggle that saved us during the surge.
Kai: thanks!! team effort all around.
Miguel: i'll mock up a photo backdrop for SF office. low effort, high chaos.
Sonia: quick reminder: keep remote gifting opt-in. no pressure.
Tess: noted. final note: celebrate safely, hydrate, and if you make a speech don't panic  we love you. :heart:
OpsBot: automated: no incidents. event-safe checklist passed. Have fun!
